integrity: The arbitrary-prime-power statement is proved algebraically. Exhaustive computations over selected small prime fields are consistency checks and are not used as proof of the infinite family.
limitations: The exact formula is proved only for the one-dimensional-module member of the semidirect-product family, equivalently the two-dimensional nonabelian Lie algebra, and uses finite-field interpolation. Equivalent older coverage in polynomial-identity language remains a literature risk because one highly relevant 1979 article was not available in full text.
title: Exact free-algebra growth for the two-dimensional affine Lie algebra over finite fields
